name: sonax-n8n-workspace
description: Development workspace for the independent Sonax VoIP and Sonax Chat community packages.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit --workspaces && node --test tests/*.test.cjs
scripts.test:n8n: npm run build && node tests/n8n/editor.cjs && node tests/n8n/smoke.cjs
scripts.pack:all: npm run build && npm pack --workspace sonax-voip --pack-destination sonax-voip && npm pack --workspace sonax-chat --pack-destination sonax-chat
